description: Angular component class for widget settings configuration, specifically for an aggregated value card widget in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AggregatedValueCardWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending WidgetSettingsComponent, managing form controls for widget display options such as subtitle, date, chart, background, and padding.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: _datePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a formatted date string based on current form date format settings.
